name: adam
description: Read the delivery package from Claude Code: screens, tables, services, journeys, contracts, boards and the change log, straight out of ADAM.

viewer_url.title: ADAM address
viewer_url.description: Where ADAM is served. Leave the default unless you were given another address.

email.title: Your ADAM e-mail
email.description: The address you sign in to ADAM with. Everything the connector reads is filtered to what this account may see.

password.title: Your ADAM password
password.description: Kept in your operating system's credential store, not in settings.json.

project.title: Package
project.description: Leave empty for the default package. Only set this if you were told to — it names one package on an ADAM serving several.
